traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills white to creamy-white, crowded, broad, with numerous shorter lamellulae
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills white to creamy-white, crowded, broad, with numerous shorter lamellulae

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: Hemispherical to convex when young, later broadly convex to flat; ochre-brown, hazel-brown to dark brown; covered with numerous pure white to cream universal-veil warts that may wash away; margin distinctly striate at maturity
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: Hemispherical to convex when young, later broadly convex to flat; ochre-brown, hazel-brown to dark brown; covered with numerous pure white to cream universal-veil warts that may wash away; margin distinctly striate at maturity

traits.label: Hymenium Attachment
traits.text: Free to narrowly adnexed
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Free to narrowly adnexed

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: White, cylindrical and tapering upward; base distinctly bulbous, with an adherent volva forming a characteristic collar or gutter-like rim and often one or more concentric rings above; membranous, pendulous white ring, usually smooth on its upper surface
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: White, cylindrical and tapering upward; base distinctly bulbous, with an adherent volva forming a characteristic collar or gutter-like rim and often one or more concentric rings above; membranous, pendulous white ring, usually smooth on its upper surface

traits.label: Spore print
traits.text: Spore print white
traits.raw: ⚪ Spore print white

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Mycorrhizal mainly with hardwoods; alone, scattered or gregariously; deciduous, mixed forests and woodland edges; summer to autumn
traits.raw: 🌲🌳 Mycorrhizal mainly with hardwoods; alone, scattered or gregariously; deciduous, mixed forests and woodland edges; summer to autumn

traits.label: Edibility
traits.text: Poisonous and psychoactive; severe neurological intoxication with agitation, confusion, hallucinations, ataxia, CNS depression and gastrointestinal symptoms
traits.raw: 😵‍💫😵 Poisonous and psychoactive; severe neurological intoxication with agitation, confusion, hallucinations, ataxia, CNS depression and gastrointestinal symptoms

traits.label: Uses & compounds
traits.text: Ibotenic acid, muscimol, muscazone, muscarine
traits.raw: ⚕️ Ibotenic acid, muscimol, muscazone, muscarine

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Fruit body medium to large; stipe ~5–15 cm long and ~0.6–3 cm thick
traits.raw: 📏 Fruit body medium to large; stipe ~5–15 cm long and ~0.6–3 cm thick

traits.label: Flesh
traits.text: White, firm, unchanging when cut or bruised; does not redden
traits.raw: 🔪 White, firm, unchanging when cut or bruised; does not redden

traits.label: Chemical reactions
traits.text: 10% KOH yellow-orange on cap flesh
traits.raw: 🧪 10% KOH yellow-orange on cap flesh

traits.label: Odour
traits.text: Mild to indistinct, sometimes slightly radish-like or raw-potato-like when bruised
traits.raw: 👃 Mild to indistinct, sometimes slightly radish-like or raw-potato-like when bruised

traits.label: Taste
traits.text: Mild, indistinct
traits.raw: 👅 Mild, indistinct

traits.label: Microscopy
traits.text: Spores broadly ellipsoid to ellipsoid, smooth, hyaline, inamyloid, ~8–12 × 6–8 µm; basidia predominantly 4-spored; clamp connections absent at basidial bases
traits.raw: 🔬 Spores broadly ellipsoid to ellipsoid, smooth, hyaline, inamyloid, ~8–12 × 6–8 µm; basidia predominantly 4-spored; clamp connections absent at basidial bases

traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Brown woodland Amanita with pure white veil warts, striate cap margin, smooth ring and characteristic gutter-like volval collar around a bulbous base
traits.raw: 🔤 Brown woodland Amanita with pure white veil warts, striate cap margin, smooth ring and characteristic gutter-like volval collar around a bulbous base
